issues.where: the central lake and the brown band around its rim
issues.what: the lake reads as a dark painted oval; the diagonal smears do not read as water, and the broad brown fringe follows the rim without a distinct wet edge or convincing shallows
issues.fix: vary the width and depth of the shallows with the basin shape, resolve the contact line, and replace the smeared streaks with wind-driven surface texture and a restrained sky reflection

issues.where: the central mountain ranges on both sides of the main valley
issues.what: the matching rows of regularly spaced pale ridges make the continent look like a stamped relief map at full-frame scale
issues.fix: break up the ridge spacing, height, and alignment, and vary the rock and snow coverage independently of the ridge pattern

issues.where: right crop, where the pale cloud bank ends against the blue-gray opening
issues.what: the cloud ends on a smooth scalloped contour while its interior is a nearly flat cream fill, making it read like a mask laid over the terrain
issues.fix: vary the cloud density and lighting through its depth and break the silhouette with translucent wisps at several scales

issues.where: upper-right crop, on the flanks of the parallel mountains
issues.what: the crests and gullies smear into soft, nearly identical grooves with the same gray highlight and dark green troughs, like molded clay
issues.fix: add distinct rock, scree, and snow detail at different scales, and vary how sharply each valley erodes and falls into shadow

issues.where: left crop, where the dark inland water meets the brighter blue bay
issues.what: the water changes color at a conspicuously straight diagonal boundary that reads as a material seam rather than a change in depth or suspended sediment
issues.fix: remove the straight boundary and blend the water color along bathymetry and currents across the join

issues.where: upper-left and lower-right crops over open ocean
issues.what: many white cloud flecks have small dark cutout-like companions and recur in the same diagonal grain, making the cloud field read like a texture stuck to the ocean
issues.fix: vary cloud height, size, and density, and soften and offset shadows according to cloud altitude and sun direction
